director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch ki tarah dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Koi baat nahi, Riya. Cricket pitch ko ek seedhi line maano; agar use do barabar parts mein baantein, beech ka point kya hoga?
Riya, 0 se 1 tak ek chocolate bar hai. Use do barabar tukdon mein todo; beech wala tukda kis fraction ka hoga?
Theek hai, Riya, dheere chalenge. 0 se 1 tak line ko barabar gaps mein baantte hain. Pehla gap kya dikhayega?
Riya, 0 se 1 tak kul paanch barabar hisse banao. Har hissa ek-paanchvaan hoga. 0 ke baad pehla nishaan kaunsa fraction hoga?
Riya, agar tum kul barabar hisse 5 keh rahi ho, haan, wahi sahi hai. Pehla hissa 1/5 hota hai. Doosra nishaan kya hoga?
Riya, sawaal hai: 0 se 1 tak 5 barabar hisse hain. 2/5 mein 2 hisse lene hain; isliye doosra nishaan 2/5 hai. Ab batao, 1/5 ke baad?
Riya, picture ko shabdon mein dekho: 0 se 1 tak paanch barabar hisse; doosra nishaan 2/5 hai. Pehla nishaan kya hoga?
Pehla nishaan 1/5 hai, kyunki 0 se ek barabar hissa liya. 0 ke baad kaunsa nishaan 2/5 hoga?
2/5 number line par doosra nishaan hai. Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.
